Hi Emily — thanks for sending these over. I pulled the attachments and started an internal intake. Quick notes and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Party details we need from you (one-pager will help):
   - Full legal entity names for signer(s) + billing entity
   - Registered addresses and tax IDs (if available)
   - Primary billing contact and PO process (email + SFTP if you send invoices)

2) Template gaps I see on a first skim:
   - Residency carve-out language (we can offer region pinning on Dedicated/Private plans)
   - IP/licensing clarity around customer prompts + models used — flagging for legal review
   - SLA measurement windows and remedy cap formatting on Exhibit B

3) Timeline proposal:
   - Internal intake + priority triage today (legal to flag top 5 clauses)
   - First-pass redline to you by 2026-10-06 EOD
   - Call to review redline and signer flow 2026-10-07 (30 min) if that works

Kimberly / Rishi — can you triage the attached MSA for residency, IP/model licensing, and indemnity cap exposure? I attached our intake checklist for capture (redwood-intake-checklist.pdf).

Emily — please also share the signer matrix (who signs what) if you have it so we can confirm the orderform path.

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-03T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: intake materials attached

Camila / Emily — I reviewed Acme_MSA_v1.docx and sketched a prioritized approach. Summary of flags below (full markups attached):

Top items to resolve (priority order):
- Data residency: Acme requests US-only. We can support region pinning on Dedicated/Private; for hosted we need to confirm region controls and contractual residency representations. Recommend carve-out language + SLA annotation.
- IP & prompts: Current drafting is broad on customer-generated content rights. Propose limited license language and a short addendum describing model-use transparency.
- Indemnity and liability caps: Acme's version has open-ended vendor indemnities. We'll propose a mutual indemnity with a negotiated cap tied to annual recurring revenue.
- Subprocessor / third-party models: Flag for security — need SOC 2 evidence and subprocessor list.

I attached a redline (Acme_MSA_markedup.docx) with inline comments. Rishi — can you confirm whether billing across two entities will require a split orderform or a single master order with separate billing exhibits?

Emily — once you share the signer matrix and confirmation on residency expectations (strict US-only vs. US-preferred), I'll generate a clean redline for your counsel to review.

Attachments: Acme_MSA_markedup.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
